description: Compute annual quality, moat, earnings-quality, and capital-allocation metrics for one exact Bullrun ticker from existing financial statements: ROIC, ROE/ROA, ROIC-vs-supplied-WACC, accruals, cash conversion, capex intensity, dividend payout/growth, diluted share-count changes, and a buyback proxy. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

estimatedWaccPct.description: Optional user-supplied WACC assumption, in percent. When omitted, ROIC-vs-WACC spread is returned as null.

taxRateFallbackPct.description: Fallback tax rate used for NOPAT only when reported tax/pretax data is missing or unusable.

ticker.description: The Bullrun ticker. Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN.

years.description: How many fiscal years of annual history to evaluate.

name: get_quality_moat_metrics
title: Get quality and moat metrics
